name: Process delivery with bounded retry and recovery

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { ok: $json.ok, status: $json.ok ? 200 : ($json.retryable ? 503 : 422), retryable: $json.retryable, idempotencyKey: $json.idempotencyKey, attempt: $json.attempt, nextAttempt: $json.retryable ? $json.attempt + 1 : undefined, recovery: !$json.ok && !$json.retryable ? 'manual_review_queue' : undefined, message: $json.ok ? 'Synthetic delivery accepted' : 'Synthetic delivery not accepted' } }}
